rules.message: PowerShell 5.1 Parser Error: Use separate tool calls, not && or ||.
Unix/CMD syntax detected. Use PowerShell equivalents: dir, Get-Content, Select-String, Get-ChildItem, 2>$null.
Git Bash paths forbidden. Use Windows paths: C:\\Users\\... or relative paths.

rules.description: Block Python command chaining in PowerShell
rules.message: Python chaining fails in PowerShell 5.1. Use 'Write then Execute' pattern: write script file, then run it.

rules.description: Use glob tool for file discovery, not find/dir
rules.message: Use glob tool for file discovery. bash find/dir is for verified commands only.

rules.description: Use read tool for directory listing
rules.message: Use read tool on directory path for clean, token-efficient listing.

rules.description: Use grep tool for content search
rules.message: Use grep tool for content search when available.
Broad directory dumps forbidden. Use glob with specific pattern or read on directory.

rules.description: Must read file after edit/write to verify
rules.message: VERIFICATION REQUIRED: After edit/write, you MUST read the file to verify the change.

rules.description: Must check exit code after bash command
rules.message: Check exit code after commands. Non-zero = diagnose before retry.

rules.description: Block claims of completion without evidence
rules.message: FALSE COMPLETION CLAIM: You claimed completion without verification evidence. Provide tool call evidence or retract.
RETRY BUDGET EXCEEDED: Same command failed twice. STOP. Change approach.
RETRY BUDGET EXCEEDED: 3 syntax variations failed. Switch tools.
Retries exhausted. You MUST: 1) State clearly what failed, 2) Switch to fundamentally different tool/method, 3) Report limitation.

rules.description: Enforce two-strike rule for tool failures
rules.message: TWO-STRIKE RULE: Same error type twice. You MUST pivot to fundamentally different tool. Do not attempt 3rd variation.
CONTEXT MANAGEMENT: Before next tool call, summarize 'Known/Unknown/Next' in reasoning.
OUTPUT COMPRESSION: Do not paste verbose outputs. Summarize in 2-3 sentences.

triggers: file not found after multiple paths
rules.message: EARLY EXIT: Stop investigating. State: 'Investigation of X yielded no results because Y. Moving to Z.'
TASK DECOMPOSITION REQUIRED: Create todo list before multi-step work. Use todowrite.

rules.description: One atomic operation per tool call
rules.message: ATOMIC OPERATIONS: One operation per call. Read → Edit → Verify as separate calls.
FABRICATION DETECTED: You referenced tool output/logs/tests that weren't actually executed.
EVIDENCE POLICY: Distinguish explicitly: Requested vs Attempted vs Happened vs Verified vs Unknown.

rules.description: Block substituting plausible explanations for unknown causes
rules.message: SPECULATION BLOCKED: Cause not established from evidence. Say: 'I cannot determine the cause from the available evidence.'
PATH FORMAT: Use C:\\Users\\... or relative paths. No Git Bash or forward-slash paths.

rules.description: Don't cd in bash - use workdir parameter
rules.message: The bash tool's workdir parameter handles paths. Don't cd inside commands.
Use feature branch + PR. Main is protected.
